name: Smart Search's Advanced Search page searches, on a desktop (1366x900) in the default FallbackOnly mode. As admin it first gives two movies genres (Blade Runner: Science Fiction and Thriller; Test Pattern: Documentary; sandbox data, the same every run), then as viewer: the page opens with Movies and Shows pressed, all libraries, and the focus in the title field; a title search ('blade') finds what /Items finds for that title and writes the search into the hash; a year range (Movies only, 2001) finds what /Items finds for Years=2001; the library Movies 2 finds what /Items finds under it; the genre field suggests the seeded genre for 'sci' (from the value index, after the edit) and a genre search finds Blade Runner; the list view shows a row with its facts; Sort by Year descending orders the cards by year; Open goes to the item's details page and Back renders the search again from the hash; Play starts the item in this browser; a link with tab and query (a saved query's link) runs its search, a second such link replaces it without a reload, and Back shows the first again; a too-early year shows its error under the field and sends nothing; no uncaught exception of ours. Screenshots smartsearch-search-*.png. Needs a sandbox seeded by Initialize-Sandbox.ps1.

steps.name: seed: genres on two movies of the Movies library (Blade Runner: Science Fiction, Thriller; Test Pattern: Documentary), sandbox data, the same every run
steps.script: const uid = ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(); const want = { 'Blade Runner': ['Science Fiction', 'Thriller'], 'Test Pattern': ['Documentary'] }; const out = {}; for (const name of Object.keys(want)) { const found = (await ApiClient.getItems(uid, { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: name, Limit: 5 })).Items.filter(i => i.Name === name); for (const f of found) { const item = await ApiClient.getItem(uid, f.Id); if ((item.Genres || []).join() !== want[name].join()) { item.Genres = want[name]; item.GenreItems = want[name].map(g => ({ Name: g })); await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Items/' + f.Id), data: JSON.stringify(item), contentType: 'application/json' }); } out[name] = (out[name] || 0) + 1; } } return out;

steps.name: viewer, in a browser of its own
page helpers (viewer)
steps.initScript:
window.__ss = {
  root: () => [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-jfss-page="search"][data-jfss-mounted] .jfss-search')].find(x => x.getClientRects().length > 0) || null,
  q: (s) => { const r = window.__ss.root(); return r ? r.querySelector(s) : null; },
  all: (s) => { const r = window.__ss.root(); return r ? [...r.querySelectorAll(s)] : []; },
  set: (s, v) => { const e = window.__ss.q(s); e.value = v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); return true; },
  ready: () => !!window.__ss.q('.jfss-scope') && !!window.__ss.q('.jfss-search-button'),
  done: () => { const c = window.__ss.q('.jfss-count'); const n = window.__ss.q('.jfss-notices'); if (c && c.textContent && !/Searching/.test(c.textContent)) return c.textContent; if (n && n.textContent) return n.textContent; return false; },
  ids: () => window.__ss.all('.jfss-card, .jfss-row').map(x => x.getAttribute('data-id')),
  names: () => window.__ss.all('.jfss-card, .jfss-row').map(x => (x.querySelector('bdi') || x).textContent.trim()),
  pressed: (s) => window.__ss.all(s).filter(b => b.getAttribute('aria-pressed') === 'true').map(b => b.textContent),
  norm: (ids) => ids.map(i => String(i).replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase()).sort().join(),
  server: async (q) => window.__ss.norm((await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), Object.assign({ Recursive: true }, q))).Items.map(i => i.Id)),
  noHScroll: () => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth && window.__ss.root().scrollWidth <= window.__ss.root().clientWidth + 1,
  box: (e) => { const r = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(r.width), Math.round(r.height)]; }
};

steps.script: __ss.set('.jfss-year-from', ''); __ss.set('.jfss-year-to', ''); const o = __ss.all('.jfss-library option').find(x => x.textContent === 'Movies 2'); __ss.set('.jfss-library', o.value); __ss.q('.jfss-search-button').click(); return o.value;

steps.name: what /Items finds for the genre: Blade Runner
back to all movies: the chip removed, Sort by Year, Descending, then the list view
the cards' years, in order
steps.eval: (async () => { const ids = __ss.ids(); const items = (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { Ids: ids.join(','), Fields: 'ProductionYear' })).Items; const year = Object.fromEntries(items.map(i => [i.Id.replace(/-/g, ''), i.ProductionYear || 0])); return { years: ids.map(i => year[i.replace(/-/g, '')]), hash: location.hash, total: ids.length, server: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, Limit: 0 })).TotalRecordCount }; })()

steps.name: newest first; every movie; sort and order in the hash
rows with their facts
steps.waitFor: (() => { const rows = __ss.all('.jfss-row'); if (!rows.length) return false; const f = rows[0].querySelector('.jfss-facts'); const b = rows[0].querySelector('.jfss-open'); return { rows: rows.length, facts: f && f.textContent, open: !!b && b.getAttribute('aria-label'), view: __ss.pressed('.jfss-view').join(), noHScroll: __ss.noHScroll() }; })()
